{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders: revenue = 999999.99
test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(test_orders)}")

# Confirm the values in test orders
print("Sample of test order revenue values:")
print(test_orders['revenue'].head())

# Check if the premise about test orders is true
assert len(test_orders) == 6, f"Expected 6 internal test orders, found {len(test_orders)}"

# Now, filter for completed orders and exclude test orders
completed_no_test = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_no_test['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}")

# Return the result
total_revenue"}
